question: An engineer is implementing VSAN 10 on multiple Cisco Nexus 5600 Series Switches and must ensure that the full zone set and active zone set are identical across the fabric. Which configuration must be implemented to meet this requirement?
options: switch(config)# zoneset activate name ZONE10 vsan 10
theory: By default, activating a zone set distributes only the active zone set to other switches in the fabric; the full zone set database, every configured zone and zone set whether active or not, is only distributed automatically if full zone set distribution is enabled. Running 'zoneset distribute full vsan 10' turns on continuous, automatic distribution of the complete zoning database (not just a one-time push), which is what's needed to guarantee the full and active zone sets stay identical across every switch in the fabric. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 8 - Zoning)
